subtitle: Your script, right where you need it.
longDescription:
Keep your words in view while giving a presentation, recording a video, or practicing a speech. Paste a script into Teleprompter and read it on your smart glasses.

Choose a scrolling speed or let the script follow your voice. Adjust the number of visible lines and control playback from the Mentra App. Requires glasses with a display. Voice-following mode uses microphone access and transcription.
